IL.source: EIA commercial prices. Electricity: Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, commercial, Illinois, year-to-date through Aug 2026. Gas: Natural Gas Prices, commercial, Illinois, 2025 annual 9.63 $/Mcf divided by 10.37 therms/Mcf. All-in average prices (include fixed charges and demand charges); no separate demand-charge model.

solar.source: Installed price by system size: LBNL, Distributed Solar & Storage, 2025 Data Update (October 2025), p. 8: 2024 national median gross installed prices for non-residential PV, 2024 $/W (DC), before incentives: up to 10 kW $3.70; 10-20 kW $3.30; 20-50 kW $3.10; 50-100 kW $2.90; 100-250 kW $2.50; 250-500 kW $2.50; 500-1,000 kW $2.00; over 1,000 kW $1.70. National medians, not Chicago contractor quotes. Values transcribed by the team from the PDF (emp.lbl.gov is not reachable from the build session, so not re-checked by Claude Code). The low and high values (-15% and +15% around the median) are a PLACEHOLDER spread: the percentiles were not transcribed. Editable per hotel (solarCostPerW). Export credit: null, so $0 per kWh, a conservative fallback until the applicable tariff is confirmed (see docs/14: Illinois 220 ILCS 5/16-107.5 and the ComEd non-residential rules must be checked for this hotel's customer class). Editable per hotel (solarExportCreditPerKWh).
